generation_brief: A 4-column, 3-row effect sheet, matching the existing Stolas and Giovanni da Modena Inferno. Sparse matte fresco planes, ochre, ivory, umber feathers, ash and muted embers; no neon, glow or extra microdetail. Row 1: sparse feather curl, torn plaster wreath with two hands and empty centre, outward scatter, falling remnants. Row 2: four animated condemned portraits with a solid umber core and jagged ivory rim. Row 3: closed ground crack, opening faces and hands, open damned faces, closing ash. Full #FF00FF chroma key, isolated cells and empty gutters.

technical_processing.alpha: Remove magenta where min(R,B)-G > 0.24; fill transparent RGB with #553c2e.
technical_processing.spill: R := R-max(0,B-G); B := min(B,G). No resizing, sharpening or painting.

acceptance: Owner review of appearance and motion pending. Collision, timing and anatomy are not changed by this effect sheet.
